blue-leader--scarif-air-support.text:
Ambush (When you play this unit, it may attack an enemy unit.)
When Played: You may pay 2 resources. If you do, move this unit to the ground arena and give 2 Experience tokens to it. (It's a ground unit.)

system-shock.text: Defeat a non-leader upgrade attached to a unit. If you do, deal 1 damage to that unit.

pegasus-tri-wing.text: When Played: You may defeat a friendly upgrade. If you do, ready this unit.

kit-fisto-s-aethersprite--good-hunting.text:
Saboteur
When Played: You may defeat any number of upgrades on a unit.

watch-this.text: Return a non-leader unit that costs 6 or less to its owner's hand. Exhaust each other enemy unit in the same arena.

sabine-wren--spectre-five.text:
Ambush (When you play this unit, she may attack an enemy unit.)
When Played: You may defeat a non-<uq> upgrade. If you control a Vigilance or Command unit, you may defeat an upgrade instead.

commence-the-festivities.text: Attack with a unit. It gains Saboteur for this attack. If you control fewer resources than an opponent, it gets +2/+0 for this attack.

masterstroke.text: Attack with a unit. It gets +1/+0 for this attack for each unit the defending player controls in its arena.

emissary-s-sheathipede.text: When Defeated: Each opponent may ready a resource.

emergency-powers.text: Choose a non-leader unit and pay any number of resources. For each resource paid this way, give an Experience token to the chosen unit.

ravager--final-imperial-command.text:
Restore 2
When you play a unit: You may have it deal damage equal to its power to a unit in the same arena.

there-is-no-conflict.text: When Played: Return any number of other upgrades on attached unit to their owners' hands.
